summary: Verified profile screen bug fix in Conactivos HR app via Playwright (mobile viewport 390x844). Login flow with admin1@conactivos.com/admin123 succeeded, Home dashboard 'Vista general' loaded, profile button (testID=profile-btn) - golden circular avatar with person icon - is visible in header. Clicking it navigates to 'Mi Perfil' screen showing all required elements: avatar with camera badge, María García, Directora de RRHH, Administrador badge, email admin1@conactivos.com, phone 555-0101, birthdate 1985-03-15, hire date 2020-01-15, and Kudos Recibidos section (0 kudos, empty state). Bug fix is FULLY WORKING. Minor non-blocking warnings observed in console: 'No route named empleados exists in nested children' (empleados route registered twice), and deprecated Image.style.tintColor + props.pointerEvents warnings.

react_native_issues.issue: Duplicate 'empleados' route registration warning: 'No route named empleados exists in nested children: [index, login, perfil, reportes, (tabs), empleados/index]'. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.
style.tintColor is deprecated. Use props.tintColor instead. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:314 (logoIcon style)
props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents (likely inside a modal/library component).

action_items: Optional: Fix Expo Router duplicate 'empleados' route warning (route appears in both root and nested children).
Optional: Migrate Image tintColor from style prop to top-level prop in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx logoIcon style.
Optional: Migrate pointerEvents from props to style.
critical_code_review_comments: perfil.tsx handles all critical flows (photo upload, profile data render, kudos) cleanly.
profile-btn testID present and working; graceful fallback between profile_photo Image and person Ionicon.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing seeded admin1@conactivos.com account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Profile screen bug fix verified. Access profile via testID='profile-btn' in top-right header of Home tab. Only minor deprecation warnings remain; no functional issues.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: profile screen inaccessible from home. Fix: added dedicated golden circular profile button (testID=profile-btn) in Home header (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:118-128) that routes to /perfil. Confirmed working end-to-end.
